title: A Chess Like Game - SandTable Chess - Where your pieces are Infantry, Tanks and Airplanes and you can steal their vehicles too!
author: 2eggs1stone
selftext:
I've been working on this Chess Variant for about a month.  I gave it the name SandTable Chess because it's a chess like game but built around modern battlefield mechanics with Infantry, Vehicles that can be crewed, destroyed, or captured (yes, you can steal your opponents vehicles). You can lay traps for your opponents with Mines, Anti-Air Missiles, and Drones.  

If there is enough interest, I'd like to make a physical board game available for purchase in the future, but the online version is free to play, either with a bot or with a friend.  While the rules for the game are locked in place (unless I identify a strategy that is unfair), I plan to continue to polish the game engine and add additional features in the future.

Check it out at [https://sandtablechess.com](https://sandtablechess.com)  
Rules: [https://sandtablechess.com/rules.html](https://sandtablechess.com/rules.html)
